translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year more than 49,000 shi of additionally assessed seed grain in Shaoxing Prefecture was remitted.

sentences.zh: 淳熙三年，臣僚言：「湖北百姓廣占官田，量輸常賦，似為過優，比議者欲從實起稅而開陳首之門。

translations.literal: In the third year of Chunxi, an official said: "Hubei commoners widely occupy government land and pay regular levies by estimate—this seems overly favorable. Recently deliberators wish to assess actual tax and open a door to self-reporting.
translations.idiomatic: In Chunxi 3 an official argued: "Hubei peasants occupy large tracts of government land and pay modest fixed dues, which some think too lenient. Deliberators now want to assess taxes on actual acreage and invite self-reporting.

sentences.zh: 殊不思朝廷往年經界，獨兩淮、京西、湖北依舊。

translations.literal: They wholly fail to consider that when the court measured fields in former years, only Two Huai, Jingxi, and Hubei were left as before.
translations.idiomatic: They forget that when the court conducted field surveys in earlier years, only the Two Huai, Jing West, and Hubei circuits were exempted.

sentences.zh: 蓋以四路被邊，土廣人稀，誘之使耕，猶懼不至，若履畝而稅，孰肯遠徙力耕，以供公上之賦哉？

translations.literal: Because these four circuits border the frontier: land is broad and people sparse; even coaxing them to farm one still fears they will not come. If tax were levied foot by foot across the mu, who would migrate far to farm strenuously to supply the state's levies?
translations.idiomatic: Those four frontier circuits are vast and sparsely settled. Even incentives to farm barely draw settlers. If every mu were taxed at full rate, who would migrate there to work the land for the state?

sentences.zh: 今湖北惟鼎、澧地接湖南，墾田稍多，自荊南、安、復、嶽、鄂、漢、沔汙萊彌望，戶口稀少，且皆江南狹鄉百姓，扶老攜幼，遠來請佃，以田畝寬而稅賦輕也。

translations.literal: Now in Hubei only Ding and Li adjoin Hunan with somewhat more reclaimed land; from Jingnan, An, Fu, Yue, E, Han, and Mian waterlogged fallow stretches as far as the eye can see, households are few, and all are narrow-district commoners from Jiangnan who bring old and young and come far to tenant, because fields are wide and tax light.
translations.idiomatic: In Hubei only Ding and Li, bordering Hunan, have somewhat more cleared land. From Jingnan through An, Fu, Yue, E, Han, and Mian, waterlogged wasteland stretches endlessly, population is thin, and settlers are mostly poor migrants from crowded Jiangnan districts who come with families to tenant land because acreage is ample and taxes light.

sentences.zh: 若從議者之言，恐於公家無一毫之益，而良民有無窮之擾矣。

translations.literal: If the deliberators' words are followed, I fear the state will gain not a hair's benefit while good people suffer endless harassment.
translations.idiomatic: If the deliberators' plan is adopted, the state will gain nothing while honest people face endless harassment.

sentences.zh: 如臣所見，且當誘以開耕，不宜恐以增稅。

translations.literal: In my view, they should be encouraged to open new land, not frightened with increased tax.
translations.idiomatic: In my view the court should encourage opening new land, not threaten people with higher taxes.

sentences.zh: 使田疇盡辟，歲收滋廣，一遇豐稔，平糴以實邊，則所省漕運亦博。

translations.literal: If fields are fully opened and yearly harvest grows, once a bumper year comes, equitable purchase to fill the frontier would save much transport cost.
translations.idiomatic: If fields are fully cleared and harvests grow, a good year would allow equitable purchase to fill frontier stores and save vast transport costs.

sentences.zh: 望其依紹興十六年詔旨，以十分為率，年增輸一分，不願開墾者，即許退田別佃。

translations.literal: I hope they follow the sixteenth-year Shaoxing edict: taking ten parts as the rate, increase payment one part per year; those unwilling to open land may return fields for others to tenant.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that the court follow the Shaoxing 16 edict: starting from a base of ten parts, increase the payment by one part each year; those unwilling to open land may surrender their fields for others to tenant.

sentences.zh: 期限稍寬，取之有漸，遠民安業，一路幸甚。

translations.literal: With deadline somewhat relaxed and collection gradual, distant people secure in their livelihood—the whole circuit would be greatly fortunate.
translations.idiomatic: With a longer deadline and gradual increases, distant settlers could live securely—a great benefit to the whole circuit.

sentences.zh: 」詔戶部議之。

translations.literal: Closing quotation. An edict ordered the Ministry of Revenue to deliberate.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered the Ministry of Revenue to consider the proposal.

sentences.zh: 四年，臣僚言：「屢赦蠲積欠，以蘇疲民，州縣不能仰承德意，至變易名色以取之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, an official said: "Repeated amnesties remit accumulated arrears to revive exhausted people, yet prefectures and counties cannot uphold the imperial intent and even change categories to collect.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year an official reported: "Repeated amnesties have remitted accumulated arrears to relieve exhausted people, yet prefectures and counties fail to honor the imperial intent and even rename dues to collect them again.

sentences.zh: 宜下漕司，如合除者毋更取之於州，州毋取之於縣，縣銷民欠籍，書其名數，諭民通知。

translations.literal: Transport offices should be instructed: where remission applies, do not collect again from prefectures; prefectures should not collect from counties; counties should cancel people's debt registers, record names and amounts, and notify the people.
translations.idiomatic: Transport offices should be instructed that remitted amounts must not be collected again from prefectures, prefectures must not pass them down to counties, and counties must cancel debt registers, record names and amounts, and notify the people.

sentences.zh: 」詔可。

translations.literal: Closing quotation. An edict approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 五年八月，詔曰：「比年以來，五穀屢登，蠶絲盈箱，嘉與海內共享阜康之樂，尚念耕夫蠶婦終歲勤動，價賤不足以償其勞。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the fifth year, an edict said: "In recent years the five grains have repeatedly ripened and mulberry silk fills boxes. I rejoice to share abundance with all within the seas, yet still mindful that plowmen and silkworm women toil all year while low prices do not repay their labor.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the fifth year an edict said: "In recent years harvests have been abundant and silk chests are full. I rejoice to share this prosperity with the realm, yet I remember that farmers and silk workers toil all year while low prices scarcely repay their labor.

sentences.zh: 郡邑兩稅，除折帛、折變自有常制，當輸正色者，毋以重價強之折錢。

translations.literal: Prefectural and county two taxes: apart from converted-silk and converted-items which have fixed rules, where original goods should be delivered, do not force conversion to cash at inflated prices.
translations.idiomatic: For prefectural and county land taxes, apart from fixed rules on silk and commodity conversion, dues owed in kind must not be forced into cash at inflated prices.

sentences.zh: 若有故違，重置於法。

translations.literal: If there is deliberate violation, heavy penalties shall be applied according to law.
translations.idiomatic: Deliberate violations shall be punished to the full extent of the law.

sentences.zh: 臨安府刻石，遍賜諸路。

translations.literal: Lin'an Prefecture carved it on stone and distributed copies to all circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Lin'an Prefecture had the edict carved in stone and copies sent to every circuit.

sentences.zh: 」六年，以諫議大夫謝廓然言：「州縣違法科斂，侵漁日甚，其咎雖在縣令，而督迫實由郡守。

translations.literal: Closing quotation. In the sixth year, on the memorial of Remonstrance and Policy Advisor Xie Kuoran: "Prefectures and counties levy illegal exactions; encroachment grows daily. Though the fault lies with magistrates, the pressure to compel them truly comes from prefects.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, Remonstrance Adviser Xie Kuoran reported: "Prefectures and counties levy illegal exactions and prey on the people more each day. Magistrates may bear the blame, but the real pressure comes from prefects.

sentences.zh: 縣令按劾，而郡守自如。

translations.literal: Magistrates were investigated and impeached, while prefects remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: Magistrates were impeached, but prefects went unpunished.

sentences.zh: 」詔：「自今凡有過需橫取，監司悉行按劾，無詳於小而略於大。」

translations.literal: Closing quotation. An edict said: "From now on, wherever there are excess demands or arbitrary collection, supervisory commissioners shall investigate and impeach all; do not scrutinize the small while overlooking the large."
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared: "Henceforth, whenever officials demand excess or seize goods arbitrarily, supervisory commissioners must investigate and impeach them all—do not fixate on petty cases while ignoring the major ones."

sentences.zh: 七年夏，大旱。

translations.literal: In the summer of the seventh year, great drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the seventh year there was a severe drought.

sentences.zh: 知南康軍朱熹應詔上封事言：「今民間二稅之入，朝廷盡取以供軍，州縣無復贏餘，於是別立名色巧取。

translations.literal: Military Prefect of Nankang Zhu Xi responded to an edict with a sealed memorial saying: "Today's receipts from the people's two taxes—the court takes all for the army; prefectures and counties no longer have surplus. Therefore they establish new categories to seize by craft.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Xi, prefect of Nankang, submitted a sealed memorial in response to an imperial call: "The court now takes all receipts from the people's land taxes to supply the army, leaving prefectures and counties with no surplus. They therefore invent new dues to extract payment by stealth.

sentences.zh: 今民貧賦重，惟有核兵籍，廣屯田，練民兵，可以漸省列屯坐食之兵，稍損州郡供軍之數。

translations.literal: Now the people are poor and levies heavy. Only by auditing military registers, expanding garrison fields, and training militia can one gradually reduce stationed troops who eat without working, and slightly cut the numbers prefectures and commanderies supply the army.
translations.idiomatic: The people are poor and taxes are heavy. Only by auditing military rolls, expanding garrison farms, and training militia can we gradually reduce idle garrison troops and trim what prefectures must supply the army.

sentences.zh: 使州縣之力浸紓，然後禁其苛斂，責其寬恤，庶幾窮困之民得保生業，無流移漂蕩之患。

translations.literal: When prefectural and county strength is gradually eased, then forbid harsh collection and require leniency and relief, so that destitute people may preserve their livelihoods and be free of the calamity of drifting displacement.
translations.idiomatic: When prefectures and counties are gradually relieved, the court can ban harsh collection and demand leniency, so impoverished people may keep their livelihoods and avoid displacement.

sentences.zh: 」八年，詔監司、太守察所部催科不擾者薦之，煩擾害民者劾之。

translations.literal: Closing quotation. In the eighth year, an edict ordered supervisory commissioners and grand administrators to examine their jurisdictions: recommend those whose tax collection does not harass, impeach those who harass and harm the people.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year an edict ordered circuit supervisors and prefects to recommend officials whose tax collection did not harass the people and to impeach those whose practices harmed them.

sentences.zh: 十一年，戶部奏：「諸路州軍檢放旱傷米數近六十萬石。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, the Ministry of Revenue reported: "Armies and prefectures of all circuits have inspected and remitted drought-damaged grain amounting to nearly 600,000 shi.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year the Ministry of Revenue reported that armies and prefectures across the circuits had inspected and remitted nearly 600,000 shi of drought-damaged grain.

sentences.zh: 上諭王淮曰：「若盡令核實，恐他年郡縣懷疑，不復檢放。

translations.literal: The emperor instructed Wang Huai: "If all are ordered verified, I fear that in future years prefectures and counties will grow wary and no longer inspect and remit.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told Wang Huai: "If we order full verification everywhere, prefectures and counties may grow wary and stop remitting drought losses in future years.

sentences.zh: 惟寧國數最多，可令漕司核實而蠲之。」

translations.literal: Only Ningguo has the largest amount; the transport commission may be ordered to verify and remit it." Closing quotation.
translations.idiomatic: Only Ningguo reported the largest amount; let the transport commission verify that case and remit it."

sentences.zh: 紹熙元年，臣僚言：「古者賦租出於民之所有，不強其所無。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shaoxi, an official said: "In antiquity land rent came from what the people possessed; they were not forced for what they lacked.
translations.idiomatic: In Shaoxi 1 an official argued: "In antiquity taxes were levied only on what people actually had; the state did not demand what they lacked.

sentences.zh: 今之為絹者，一倍折而為錢，再倍折而為銀。

translations.literal: For today's silk producers, it is converted once at double rate to cash, and converted again at double rate to silver.
translations.idiomatic: Today silk owed in kind is first converted to cash at twice the statutory rate, then converted again to silver at twice that rate.

sentences.zh: 銀愈貴，錢愈艱得，穀愈不可售，使民賤糶而貴折，則大熟之歲反為民害。

translations.literal: As silver grows costlier, cash harder to obtain, and grain harder to sell, forcing the people to sell cheap and convert dear—then even a great harvest year becomes harm to the people.
translations.idiomatic: As silver rises in price, cash grows scarce, and grain becomes unsellable, people must sell grain cheaply yet pay conversion at inflated rates—so even bumper harvests become a curse.

sentences.zh: 願詔州郡：凡多取而多折者，重置於罰；

translations.literal: I wish an edict to prefectures and commanderies: wherever there is over-collection and excessive conversion, heavy penalties shall be applied;
translations.idiomatic: I ask that the throne instruct prefectures: officials who over-collect or over-convert should face severe penalties;

sentences.zh: 民有糶不售者，令常平就糴，異時歲歉，平價以糶。

translations.literal: where the people have grain they cannot sell, order the Ever-Normal Granaries to purchase nearby; when years later harvest fails, sell at fair price.
translations.idiomatic: when farmers cannot sell their grain, Ever-Normal Granaries should buy it locally and release it at fair prices in bad years.

sentences.zh: 庶於民無傷，於國有補。

translations.literal: Perhaps thus the people are unharmed and the state benefited.
translations.idiomatic: This would protect the people without harming the state.

sentences.zh: 」詔從之。

translations.literal: Closing quotation. An edict approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 秘書監楊萬里奏：「民輸粟於官謂之苗，舊以一斛輸一斛，今以二斛輸一斛矣。

translations.literal: Director of the Secretariat Yang Wanli memorialized: "Grain the people deliver to government is called seed tax. Formerly one hu delivered was one hu owed; now two hu are delivered for one hu owed.
translations.idiomatic: Secretariat Director Yang Wanli reported: "Grain paid to the state is called seed tax. Formerly one bushel owed meant one bushel paid; now two must be paid for one.

sentences.zh: 輸帛於官謂之稅，舊以正絹為稅絹，今正絹外有和買矣。

translations.literal: Silk delivered to government is called tax silk. Formerly regular silk was tax silk; now beyond regular silk there is compulsory purchase as well.
translations.idiomatic: Silk paid to the state is land tax in kind. Formerly only standard silk was owed; now compulsory purchase is added on top.

sentences.zh: 舊和買官給其直，或以錢，或以鹽，今皆無之，又以絹估直而倍折其錢矣。

translations.literal: Formerly in compulsory purchase the government paid the price, sometimes in cash, sometimes in salt; now all this is gone, and silk is appraised and cash converted at double rate.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly the state paid for compulsory purchases in cash or salt; now it pays nothing and converts the owed silk to cash at twice the appraised value.

sentences.zh: 舊稅畝一錢輸免役一錢，今歲增其額，不知所止矣。

translations.literal: Formerly one cash per mu of tax was one cash of labor-exemption; now the quota rises yearly with no known limit.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly the labor-exemption fee matched the land tax at one cash per mu; now the quota rises every year with no end in sight.

sentences.zh: 既一倍其粟，數倍其帛，又數倍其錢，而又有月樁錢、版帳錢、不知幾倍於祖宗之舊，又幾倍於漢、唐之制乎。

translations.literal: Having doubled grain, multiplied silk several times, and multiplied cash several times, there are also monthly advance payments and ledger fees—I know not how many times beyond the ancestral custom, and how many times beyond Han and Tang systems.
translations.idiomatic: Grain has been doubled, silk multiplied several times over, cash several times again—and on top of that come monthly advance payments and ledger fees. Who knows how many times this exceeds the founders' levies, let alone Han and Tang practice?

sentences.zh: 此猶東南之賦可知也，至於蜀賦之額外無名者，不可得而知也。

translations.literal: This much can still be known of southeast levies; as for Sichuan levies beyond quota with no name, they cannot be known.
translations.idiomatic: Even these figures cover only the southeast; the unnamed extra levies in Sichuan cannot even be calculated.

sentences.zh: 陛下欲薄賦斂，當節用度。

translations.literal: If Your Majesty wishes to lighten levies, expenditures should be restrained.
translations.idiomatic: If Your Majesty wishes to lighten taxes, spending must be cut first.

sentences.zh: 用節而後財可積，財積而後國可足，國足而後賦可減，賦減而後民可富，民富而後邦可寧。

translations.literal: When use is restrained, wealth can be stored; when wealth is stored, the state can be sufficed; when the state is sufficed, levies can be reduced; when levies are reduced, the people can be enriched; when the people are enriched, the realm can be tranquil.
translations.idiomatic: Restrain spending and revenue can accumulate; with revenue accumulated the state is secure; when the state is secure taxes can fall; when taxes fall the people prosper; when the people prosper the realm is at peace.

sentences.zh: 不然，日復日，歲復歲，臣未知其所終也。」

translations.literal: Otherwise, day after day, year after year, your servant knows not where it will end." Closing quotation.
translations.idiomatic: Otherwise, day after day and year after year, I cannot see where this will end."

translations.literal: Opening angle bracket marking an editorial note.
translations.idiomatic: Opening bracket for an editorial note.

sentences.zh: （時金主璟新立，萬里迓使客於淮，聞其蠲民間房園地基錢，罷鄉村官酒坊，減鹽價，除田租，使虛譽達於吾境，故因轉對而有是言也。）〉

translations.literal: (At this time the Jin ruler Jin Zhang newly ascended; Wanli received envoys at the Huai, heard that they remitted commoners' charges on house gardens and foundation land, abolished village and county official distilleries, reduced salt prices, and remitted field rent, causing empty reputation to reach our borders; therefore on a rotating audience he spoke thus.) Closing bracket.
translations.idiomatic: (At the time the new Jin emperor Shizong had just ascended the throne. Yang Wanli received envoys on the Huai frontier and heard that the Jin had remitted taxes on house gardens and foundations, abolished official village distilleries, cut salt prices, and waived field rent—empty boasts that reached our border. Hence his remarks at the rotating audience.) Closing bracket.

sentences.zh: 二年，詔曰：「朕惟為政之道，莫先於養民。

translations.literal: In the second year, an edict said: "I consider that in the way of governing, nothing comes before nourishing the people.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year an edict declared: "In governing, nothing comes before caring for the people.

sentences.zh: 故自即位以來，蠲除甚賦，頒宣寬條，嘉與四方臻於安富。

translations.literal: Therefore since accession I have remitted heavy levies, promulgated lenient provisions, and rejoiced to share with all quarters in reaching peace and wealth.
translations.idiomatic: Since my accession I have remitted heavy taxes, issued lenient policies, and sought peace and prosperity for the realm.

sentences.zh: 郡守、縣令，最近民者也。

translations.literal: Prefects and magistrates are those nearest the people.
translations.idiomatic: Prefects and magistrates are the officials closest to the people.

sentences.zh: 誠能拊循惠愛，以承休德，庶幾政平訟理之效。

translations.literal: If they truly can comfort and cherish with benevolence, inheriting the fortunate virtue, then perhaps the effect of peaceful government and settled litigation.
translations.idiomatic: If they truly care for the people with benevolence and embody the throne's goodwill, government will be fair and lawsuits few.

sentences.zh: 今采之人言，乃聞科斂先期，競務辦集，而民之虛實不問；

translations.literal: Now gathering people's words, I hear that collection is moved forward in date, all striving to complete quotas, while the people's strength or weakness is not asked;
translations.idiomatic: Yet I hear that officials rush collections ahead of schedule to meet quotas without asking whether the people can afford them;

sentences.zh: 追呼相繼，敢為椎剝，而民之安否不恤。

translations.literal: successive summons to pay follow, they dare to flay and strip, while the people's safety or peril is not heeded.
translations.idiomatic: they hound taxpayers relentlessly and grind them down without regard for their welfare.

sentences.zh: 財計之外，治理蔑聞，甚不稱朕委屬之意。

translations.literal: Beyond revenue reckoning, governance is barely heard of—this greatly fails to match my trust in them.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond balancing accounts they show no governance at all—far from what I expect of them.

sentences.zh: 國用有常，固在經理，而非掊克督趣以為能也。

translations.literal: State expenses have fixed norms; they lie in proper management, not in extortion and urgent driving as ability.
translations.idiomatic: State finances have fixed needs and require sound management—not squeezing the people as a mark of ability.

sentences.zh: 知本末先後之誼，此朕所貴於守令者。

translations.literal: Knowing the principle of root and branch, first and after—this is what I value in prefects and magistrates.
translations.idiomatic: Understanding what comes first and what follows—this is what I value in local officials.

sentences.zh: 繼自今以軫恤為心，以牧養為務，俾民安業，時予汝嘉。」

translations.literal: From now take compassion as your heart and nurturing as your task, so the people secure in their occupations; then I shall praise you." Closing quotation.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth hold compassion in your hearts and the people's welfare as your duty, so they may live in peace—I will reward those who do."

sentences.zh: 慶元二年，詔浙江東、西夏稅、和買綢絹並依紹興十六年詔旨折納。

translations.literal: In the second year of Qingyuan, an edict ordered that summer tax and compulsory purchase of silk in Zhejiang East and West Circuits all follow the Shaoxing sixteenth-year edict for conversion payment.
translations.idiomatic: In Qingyuan 2 an edict required Zhejiang East and West to convert summer tax and compulsory-purchase silk according to the Shaoxing 16 conversion rules.

translations.literal: Opening angle bracket marking an editorial note.
translations.idiomatic: Opening bracket for an editorial note.

sentences.zh: （紹興十六年詔旨：絹三分折錢，七分本色；

translations.literal: (Shaoxing sixteenth-year edict: for silk, three parts converted to cash, seven parts in original goods;
translations.idiomatic: (Shaoxing 16 edict: for silk, thirty percent paid in cash and seventy percent in kind;

sentences.zh: 綢八分折錢，二分本色。）〉

translations.literal: for thin silk, eight parts converted to cash, two parts in original goods.) Closing bracket.
translations.idiomatic: for gauze silk, eighty percent in cash and twenty percent in kind.) Closing bracket.

sentences.zh: 嘉熙二年臣僚言：「陛下自登大寶以來，蠲賦之詔無歲無之，而百姓未沾實惠。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jiadao, an official said: "Since Your Majesty ascended the great throne, remission edicts have come every year without fail, yet commoners have not tasted real benefit.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiadao 2 an official reported: "Since Your Majesty's accession, tax-remission edicts have been issued every year, yet the people have received no real relief.

sentences.zh: 蓋民輸率先期歸於吏胥、攬戶，及遇詔下，則所放者吏胥之物，所倚閣者攬戶之錢，是以寬恤之詔雖頒，愁歎之聲如故。

translations.literal: Because the people's payments are first collected ahead of schedule by clerks and tax contractors; when an edict arrives, what is remitted is the clerks' goods, what is deferred is the contractors' cash—thus though leniency edicts are promulgated, sounds of grief remain as before.
translations.idiomatic: Payments reach clerks and tax contractors early; when remission edicts arrive, only clerks' holdings are released and contractors' debts deferred—so despite imperial leniency, the people's cries of hardship continue.

sentences.zh: 嘗覺漢史恤民之詔，多減明年田租。

translations.literal: I once noticed that Han historical edicts comforting the people mostly reduced next year's field rent.
translations.idiomatic: Han edicts relieving the people often cut the following year's land tax.

sentences.zh: 今宜仿漢故事，如遇朝廷行大惠，則以今年下詔，明年減租，示民先知減數，則吏難為欺，民拜實賜矣。

translations.literal: Now we should follow Han precedent: when the court grants great benefit, issue the edict this year and reduce rent next year, showing the people the reduction amount in advance—then clerks cannot deceive, and the people receive real grace.
translations.idiomatic: The court should follow Han precedent: announce a major remission this year and apply the cut to next year's tax, so people know the amount in advance, clerks cannot cheat, and the benefit reaches them.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: Closing quotation. Approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 淳祐八年，監察御史兼崇政殿說書陳求魯奏：「本朝仁政有餘，而王制未備。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Chunyou, Supervising Censor and Lecturer at the Chongzheng Hall Chen Qiulu memorialized: "Our dynasty has benevolent policy in surplus, yet royal institutions are not complete.
translations.idiomatic: In Chunyou 8 Supervising Censor Chen Qiulu, also lecturer at the Chongzheng Hall, reported: "Our dynasty is rich in benevolent measures, yet its fundamental institutions remain incomplete.

sentences.zh: 今之兩稅，本大曆之弊法也。

translations.literal: Today's two taxes were originally the defective law of the Dali era.
translations.idiomatic: Today's land tax system is inherited from the flawed Dali-era levy.

sentences.zh: 常賦之入尚為病，況預借乎？

translations.literal: Even regular tax receipts are already affliction—how much more advance borrowing?
translations.idiomatic: Even regular taxes already burden the people—how much worse is advance collection?

sentences.zh: 預借一歲未已也，至於再，至於三；

translations.literal: Advance borrowing one year is not ended; it reaches two, reaches three;
translations.idiomatic: One year of advance collection is not enough—they advance two years, then three;

sentences.zh: 預借三歲未已也，至於四，至於五。

translations.literal: advance borrowing three years is not ended; it reaches four, reaches five.
translations.idiomatic: three years' taxes are not enough—they advance four, then five.

sentences.zh: 竊聞今之州縣，有借淳祐十四年者矣。

translations.literal: I have privately heard that among today's prefectures and counties, some already borrow against the fourteenth year of Chunyou.
translations.idiomatic: I hear that some prefectures and counties are already collecting taxes owed as far ahead as Chunyou 14.

sentences.zh: 以百畝之家計之，罄其永業，豈足支數年之借乎？

translations.literal: Calculating for a household of one hundred mu, exhausting their hereditary property—could it suffice to meet several years' advance?
translations.idiomatic: For a household farming a hundred mu, even if they sold all their hereditary land, could they meet several years of advance payments?

sentences.zh: 操縱出於權宜，官吏得以簸弄，上下為奸，公私俱困。

translations.literal: Manipulation arises from expedience; officials can toss and turn accounts; superiors and subordinates collude in fraud; public and private alike are exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: What began as an expedient lets officials manipulate accounts, breeds collusion between superiors and subordinates, and exhausts both the state and the people.

sentences.zh: 臣愚謂今日救弊之策，其大端有四焉：宜采夏侯太初並省州郡之議，俾縣令得以直達於朝廷；

translations.literal: Your servant foolishly holds that today's policy to rescue abuses has four major points: adopt Xiahou Tuan's proposal to merge and reduce prefectures and commanderies, so magistrates may reach the court directly;
translations.idiomatic: I believe the remedy has four main parts: adopt Xiahou Tuan's proposal to consolidate prefectures so magistrates may report directly to the throne;

sentences.zh: 用宋元嘉六年為斷之法，俾縣令得以究心於撫字；

translations.literal: use the Liu Song Yuanjia sixth-year law on term limits, so magistrates may devote their hearts to nurturing the people;
translations.idiomatic: apply the Liu Song Yuanjia 6 term-limit law so magistrates can focus on governing the people;

sentences.zh: 法藝祖出朝紳為令之典，以重其權；

translations.literal: follow Founder Taizu's precedent of appointing court gentry as magistrates, to weight their authority;
translations.idiomatic: restore Taizu's practice of sending court officials to serve as magistrates, to increase their authority;

sentences.zh: 遵光武擢卓茂為三公之意，以激其氣。

translations.literal: follow Emperor Guangwu's intent in elevating Zhuo Mao to the Three Ducal Ministers, to rouse their spirit.
translations.idiomatic: follow Emperor Guangwu's example of promoting Zhuo Mao to the highest office, to inspire their ambition.

sentences.zh: 然後為之正其經界，明其版籍，約其妄費，裁其橫斂，則預借可革，民瘼有瘳矣。」

translations.literal: Then for them rectify field boundaries, clarify household registers, restrain wasteful spending, cut arbitrary collection—then advance borrowing can be reformed and the people's afflictions relieved." Closing quotation.
translations.idiomatic: Then fix field boundaries, clarify registers, curb wasteful spending, and stop arbitrary levies—advance collection can be abolished and the people's suffering eased."

sentences.zh: 咸淳十年，侍御史陳堅、殿中侍御史陳過等奏：「今東南之民力竭矣，西北之邊患棘矣，諸葛亮所謂危急存亡之時也。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Xianchun, Attendant Censor Chen Jian, Palace Censor Chen Guo, and others memorialized: "Now southeast people's strength is exhausted, northwest frontier peril is urgent—it is what Zhuge Liang called the hour of peril, crisis, survival, and extinction.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianchun 10 Censors Chen Jian and Chen Guo reported: "The southeast is exhausted, the northwest frontier is in peril—this is the moment Zhuge Liang called one of survival or extinction.

sentences.zh: 而邸第戚畹、御前寺觀，田連阡陌，亡慮數千萬計，皆巧立名色，盡蠲二稅。

translations.literal: Yet mansions of the nobility and imperial consort clans, and imperial temples—fields link path upon path, reckoned at no less than tens of millions, all craft new categories and wholly remit the two taxes.
translations.idiomatic: Yet noble mansions, consort clans, and imperial temples hold vast estates worth tens of millions of strings, all exempt from land taxes through invented categories.

sentences.zh: 州縣乏興，鞭撻黎庶，鬻妻賣子，而鍾鳴鼎食之家，蒼頭廬兒，漿酒藿肉；

translations.literal: Prefectures and counties lack revenue, lash the common people, sell wives and children—while households where bells ring and tripods serve food have servants and lackeys drinking diluted wine and eating bean soup;
translations.idiomatic: Prefectures starve for revenue, flog commoners, and drive families to sell wives and children—while great households dine in luxury and servants drink wine and eat meat;

sentences.zh: 琳宮梵宇之流，安居暇食，優遊死生。

translations.literal: Buddhist halls and temples live at ease with leisure to eat, drifting free through life and death.
translations.idiomatic: Buddhist temples live in idleness and ease, untouched by hardship.

sentences.zh: 安平無事之時尤且不可，而況艱難多事之際乎？

translations.literal: Even in peaceful, uneventful times this could not be tolerated—how much less in times of hardship and many affairs?
translations.idiomatic: This was intolerable even in peaceful times—how much more so now?

sentences.zh: 今欲寬邊患，當紓民力；

translations.literal: Now if we wish to ease frontier peril, we must relieve people's strength;
translations.idiomatic: To ease the frontier crisis, the people must first be relieved;

sentences.zh: 欲紓民力，當紓州縣，則邸第、寺觀之常賦，不可姑息而不加厘正也。

translations.literal: if we wish to relieve people's strength, we must relieve prefectures and counties—then regular levies on mansions and temples cannot be indulged without rectification.
translations.idiomatic: to relieve the people, prefectures and counties must be relieved—and that means regular taxes on mansions and temples cannot be left untouched.

sentences.zh: 望與二三大臣亟議行之。

translations.literal: I hope Your Majesty will urgently discuss and carry this out with the chief ministers.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that Your Majesty urgently discuss this with the chief ministers and put it into effect.

sentences.zh: 」詔可。

translations.literal: Closing quotation. An edict approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 建炎二年，初復鈔旁定帖錢，命諸路提刑司掌之。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jianyan, the verification-stamp side registration fee was first restored; all circuits' penal-intendant offices were ordered to administer it.
translations.idiomatic: In Jianyan 2 the deed registration stamp fee was restored and assigned to each circuit's penal-intendant office.

sentences.zh: 紹興二年，詔偽造券旁者並依軍法。

translations.literal: In the second year of Shaoxing, an edict ordered that forgery of coupon margins be punished under military law.
translations.idiomatic: In Shaoxing 2 forgery of deed margins was made punishable under military law.

sentences.zh: 五年三月，詔諸州勘合錢貫收十文足。

translations.literal: In the third month of the fifth year, an edict fixed verification money at ten cash per string in all prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the fifth year an edict set verification fees at ten cash per string of cash nationwide.

sentences.zh: 勘合錢，即所謂鈔旁定帖錢也。

translations.literal: Verification money is what is called the note-margin registration fee.
translations.idiomatic: Verification money was the deed registration stamp fee.

sentences.zh: 初令諸州通判印賣田宅契紙，自今民間爭田，執白契者勿用。

translations.literal: At first all prefectures' vice-prefects were ordered to stamp and sell land and house contract paper; from now in common disputes over fields, plain contracts are not to be accepted.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectural vice-prefects were first ordered to stamp and sell official deed paper; in land disputes, informal contracts would no longer be accepted.

sentences.zh: 十有一月，以調度不足，詔諸路州縣出賣戶帖，令民具田宅之數而輸其直。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, because provisioning was insufficient, an edict ordered prefectures and counties of all circuits to sell household registers, requiring people to report numbers of fields and houses and pay the price.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, with revenues insufficient, an edict ordered prefectures to sell household deed registers and charge people according to their holdings.

sentences.zh: 既而以苛擾稽緩，乃立價：凡坊郭鄉村出等戶皆三十千，鄉村五等、坊郭九等戶皆一千，凡六等，惟閩、廣下戶差減；

translations.literal: Because harsh harassment delayed collection, fixed prices were set: urban and rural top-rank households all thirty thousand; rural fifth-rank and urban ninth-rank households all one thousand—six grades in all; only in Min and Guang were lower households reduced somewhat;
translations.idiomatic: Harsh collection caused delays, so fixed rates were set: top urban and rural households paid thirty thousand cash; fifth-rank rural and ninth-rank urban households paid one thousand—six grades in all, with reduced rates for lower households in Fujian and Guangdong;

sentences.zh: 期三月足輸送行在，旱傷及四分以上者聽旨。

translations.literal: deadline three months for full payment sent to the temporary capital; where drought damage reached four-tenths or more, await imperial decision.
translations.idiomatic: payment was due within three months and sent to the temporary capital; where drought damage exceeded forty percent, special orders applied.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，先是，諸州人戶典賣田宅契稅錢所收窠名，七分隸經、總製，三分屬係省。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year: formerly, contract tax money collected when people pawned or sold fields and houses—seven-tenths went to the Commissariat and General Supplies, three-tenths to the provincial accounts.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year: previously, deed taxes on land sales were divided seventy percent to commissariat and general supplies offices and thirty percent to provincial accounts.

sentences.zh: 至是，總領四川財賦王之望言，請從本所措置拘收，以供軍用，詔從之。

translations.literal: At this time Director-General of Sichuan Finance Wang Zhiwang said he requested that his office arrange collection and hold it for military use; an edict approved.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhiwang, director of Sichuan finance, asked to collect these funds locally for military use; the court approved.

sentences.zh: 凡嫁資、遺囑及民間葬地，皆令投契納稅，一歲中得錢四百六十七萬餘引，而極邊所捐八郡及盧、夔等未輸者十九郡不與焉。

translations.literal: Marriage dowries, wills, and commoners' burial lands—all were ordered to file contracts and pay tax; in one year more than 4,670,000 strings were obtained, while eight frontier counties that had remitted and nineteen prefectures including Lu and Kui that had not yet paid were not included.
translations.idiomatic: Dowries, wills, and burial plots all required stamped contracts and taxes; within a year more than 4.67 million strings were collected, excluding eight frontier counties granted remission and nineteen prefectures including Luzhou and Kuizhou that had not yet complied.

sentences.zh: 乾道五年，戶部尚書曾懷言：「四川立限拘錢數百萬緡，婺州亦得錢三十餘萬緡，他路恬不加意。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Qiandao, Minister of Revenue Zeng Huai said: "Sichuan fixed deadlines and collected several million strings; Wuzhou also obtained more than 300,000 strings—other circuits calmly pay no attention."
translations.idiomatic: In Qiandao 5 Revenue Minister Zeng Huai reported: "Sichuan collected several million strings under deadline; Wuzhou gathered more than 300,000—yet other circuits ignore the policy entirely."

sentences.zh: 」詔：「百姓白契，期三月自陳，再期百日輸稅，通判拘入總製帳。

translations.literal: Closing quotation. An edict: "For commoners' plain contracts, a deadline of three months to self-report; a second deadline of one hundred days to pay tax; vice-prefects collect into general supplies accounts.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered: "Households with informal contracts have three months to declare them and another hundred days to pay tax; vice-prefects must deposit the revenue in general supplies accounts.

sentences.zh: 輸送及十一萬緡者，知、通推賞；

translations.literal: Where payment sent reached 110,000 strings, prefect and vice-prefect receive commended promotion;
translations.idiomatic: prefects and vice-prefects who forwarded 110,000 strings or more would be rewarded;

sentences.zh: 違期不首，及輸錢違期者，許人告，論如律。

translations.literal: those overdue in not reporting, and those overdue in paying—informants may accuse, punished according to law.
translations.idiomatic: those who failed to report or pay on time could be reported and punished by law.

sentences.zh: 」淳熙六年，敕令所進《重修淳熙法》，有收舟、驢、駝、馬契書之稅，帝命刪之，曰：「恐後世有算及舟車之言。」

translations.literal: Closing quotation. In the sixth year of Chunxi, when the Statutes Office submitted the Revised Chunxi Code, there was tax on contracts for boats, donkeys, camels, and horses; the emperor ordered it deleted, saying: "I fear later ages may speak of taxing boats and carts."
translations.idiomatic: In Chunxi 6, when the Statutes Office submitted the Revised Chunxi Code with taxes on boat, donkey, camel, and horse contracts, the emperor ordered them removed, saying: "I fear future generations will say the state taxed boats and carts."

sentences.zh: 建炎三年，張浚節制川、陝，承製以同主管川、秦茶馬趙開為隨軍轉運使，總領四川財賦。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jianyan, Zhang Jun directed Sichuan and Shaanxi; by imperial order he appointed Co-Director of Sichuan and Qin Tea-Horse Office Zhao Kai as army transport commissioner, director-general of Sichuan revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In Jianyan 3 Zhang Jun, commander of Sichuan and Shaanxi, appointed Zhao Kai, co-director of the Sichuan-Qin Tea and Horse Office, as army transport commissioner and director of Sichuan finance.

sentences.zh: 自蜀有西師，益、利諸司已用便宜截三路上供錢。

translations.literal: Since western armies were in Shu, offices of Yi and Li had already used discretionary authority to intercept funds supplied from the three routes.
translations.idiomatic: Once western armies were stationed in Shu, the Yi and Li offices had already diverted tribute funds from the three supply routes.

translations.idiomatic: (Cloth and silk from Sichuan sent to Shaanxi, Hedong, and Jing West.) Closing bracket.

translations.literal: In the autumn of the fourth year, then all funds from Ever-Normal Granary market sites since Yuanfeng were fully raised,

translations.idiomatic: (That year the first levy was 330,000 bolts, to be abolished once the frontier quieted.

translations.idiomatic: In Shaoxing 16 levies in Li and Kui were cut by 30,000 bolts; only East and West Sichuan's 300,000 bolts remain unchanged to this day.) Closing bracket.

translations.idiomatic: next came appraisal and cash conversion of miscellaneous silk lots,

translations.idiomatic: (That is, tribute cloth from the three supply routes, 300,000 bolts per year.

translations.literal: West Sichuan assessed eleven strings per bolt, East Sichuan ten strings.
translations.idiomatic: West Sichuan charged eleven strings per bolt, East Sichuan ten.

sentences.zh: 自紹興二十五年至慶元初，兩川並減至六引。）〉

translations.idiomatic: From Shaoxing 25 through the start of Qingyuan, both circuits were cut to six strings per bolt.) Closing bracket.

translations.idiomatic: next came cloth-appraisal charges,

translations.literal: (In the six prefectures of Chengdu, Chongqing, Peng, Han, Qiong, and Yongkang—from the Tiansheng era onward the government bought cloth at three hundred cash per bolt, which greatly benefited the people; afterward payment ceased.
translations.idiomatic: (In Chengdu, Chongqing, Peng, Han, Qiong, and Yongkang, since the Tiansheng era the government had purchased cloth at three hundred cash per bolt—a great convenience for the people—until payments ceased.

sentences.zh: 至是，宣撫司又令民匹輸估錢三引，歲七十餘萬匹，為錢二百餘萬引。

translations.literal: At this time the Pacification Commission again ordered the people to submit three strings of appraisal cash per bolt—more than 700,000 bolts annually, totaling more than two million strings.
translations.idiomatic: By then the Pacification Commission required three strings of appraisal cash per bolt of cloth—over 700,000 bolts a year, worth more than two million strings.

translations.idiomatic: By the start of Qingyuan repeated cuts had reduced the sum to a little over 1.3 million strings.) Closing bracket.

translations.literal: next, accumulated principal and interest of the Ever-Normal Granary offices,
translations.idiomatic: next came accumulated principal and interest in Ever-Normal Granary accounts,

translations.idiomatic: In Jianyan 1 Vice Director Yu Ruli of the Palace Department was sent to gather more than eight million strings; by then those funds were seized for the army.) Closing bracket.

translations.literal: Generally, beyond the normal levies of the previous court, money increased by 20,680,000 strings annually—and tea was not included.
translations.idiomatic: In all, beyond the former dynasty's regular taxes, annual revenue rose by 20.68 million strings—not counting tea.

sentences.zh: 自是軍儲稍充，而蜀民始困矣。

translations.literal: From this point army stores were somewhat filled, and the people of Shu began to suffer.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter army stores recovered somewhat, but the people of Shu began to feel the strain.

sentences.zh: 紹興五年，浚召拜尚書右僕射，以席益為四川安撫製置大使，趙開為四川都轉運使。

translations.literal: In Shaoxing fifth year, Jun was summoned and appointed Right Vice Director of the Ministry of Works; Xi Yi was made Sichuan Pacification and Preparedness Grand Commissioner, and Zhao Kai was made Sichuan Chief Transport Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In Shaoxing 5 Zhang Jun was recalled as Right Vice Director of the Ministry of Works; Xi Yi became Sichuan pacification and preparedness commissioner, and Zhao Kai became chief transport commissioner of Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 益頗侵用軍期錢，開訴於朝，又數增錢引，而軍計猶不給。

translations.literal: Yi rather frequently encroached on military deadline funds; Kai appealed to the court, and repeatedly increased paper notes—yet military accounts still fell short.
translations.idiomatic: Xi Yi frequently diverted military deadline funds; Zhao Kai appealed to court, and repeatedly expanded paper-note issues—yet army finances still ran short.

sentences.zh: 六年，以龍圖閣直學士李迨代開為都轉運使。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Academician Exempt from Court Attendance of the Dragon Diagram Hall Li Dai replaced Kai as chief transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Li Dai, academician of the Dragon Diagram Hall, replaced Zhao Kai as chief transport commissioner.

sentences.zh: 都官員外郎馮康國言：「四川地狹民貧，祖宗時，正稅重者折科稍輕，正稅輕者折科稍重，二者平準，所以無偏重偏輕之患。

translations.literal: Department of Justice Vice Director Feng Kangguo said: "Sichuan's land is narrow and its people poor. In the times of the imperial ancestors, where regular tax was heavy, commuted levies were somewhat lighter; where regular tax was light, commuted levies were somewhat heavier—the two balanced, and so there was no problem of excess weight on one side or excess lightness on the other.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Director Feng Kangguo of the Justice Department said: "Sichuan is cramped and its people poor. Under the imperial ancestors, where regular taxes were heavy, commuted levies were lighter; where regular taxes were light, commuted levies were heavier—the two balanced each other, avoiding both over- and under-taxation.

sentences.zh: 百有餘年，民甚安之。

translations.literal: For more than a hundred years the people lived in great peace.
translations.idiomatic: For more than a century the people lived in peace.

sentences.zh: 近年，漕、總二司輒更舊法，反覆紐折，取數務多，致民棄業逃移。

translations.literal: In recent years the transport and general-supplies offices arbitrarily changed the old law, repeatedly twisting commutation, seeking as much revenue as possible—causing the people to abandon their livelihoods and flee.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years transport and general-supplies offices have altered the old law, endlessly twisting commutation to maximize revenue—driving people to abandon their livelihoods and flee.

sentences.zh: 望並罷之，一遵舊制。

translations.literal: It is hoped that all be abolished and the old system followed in full.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that these changes be abolished and the old system restored in full.

sentences.zh: 」詔如所請，令憲臣察其不如法者。

translations.literal: Closing quotation. An edict granted the request and ordered censorial officials to investigate those not conforming to law.
translations.idiomatic: The court granted the request and ordered censorial officials to investigate violations.

sentences.zh: 七年三月，迨以贍軍錢糧令四路漕臣分認，而榷茶錢不用，蜀人不以為是。

translations.literal: In the third month of the seventh year, Dai assigned army-support funds and grain for the four circuits' transport commissioners to share responsibility, while not using tea monopoly money—the people of Shu disapproved.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the seventh year Li Dai assigned army-support funds and grain among the four circuits' transport commissioners and refused to use tea monopoly revenue—a policy Shu did not accept.

sentences.zh: 九月，浚罷，趙鼎為尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Jun was dismissed; Zhao Ding became Left Vice Director of the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Zhang Jun was dismissed and Zhao Ding became Left Vice Director of the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 十有一月，以直秘閣張深主管四川茶馬，迨請祠。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Zhang Shen of the Secretariat Archive was put in charge of Sichuan tea and horses; Dai requested leave for temple service.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Zhang Shen was placed in charge of Sichuan tea and horses, and Li Dai requested leave for temple service.

sentences.zh: 八年二月，命深及宣撫司參議官陳遠猷並兼四川轉運副使。

translations.literal: In the second month of the eighth year, Shen and Pacification Commission Adviser Chen Yuanyou were both additionally appointed Sichuan transport vice commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the eighth year Shen and Pacification Commission adviser Chen Yuanyou were both appointed vice transport commissioners of Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 席益以憂去，樞密直學士胡世將代之。

translations.literal: Xi Yi left due to mourning; Privy Council Academician Hu Shijiang replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: Xi Yi left office in mourning and Privy Council academician Hu Shijiang replaced him.

sentences.zh: 十月，鼎罷，秦檜獨相。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, Ding was dismissed; Qin Hui alone served as chief councilor.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Zhao Ding was dismissed and Qin Hui became sole chief councilor.

sentences.zh: 九年，和議成。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, the peace agreement was concluded.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year peace was concluded with the Jin.

sentences.zh: 簽書樞密院事樓炤宣諭陝西還，以金四千兩、銀二十萬兩輸激賞庫，皆取諸蜀者。

translations.literal: Privy Council Signatory Lou Zhao, returning from proclaiming the edict in Shaanxi, delivered four thousand taels of gold and two hundred thousand taels of silver to the Incentive-Reward Vault—all taken from Shu.
translations.idiomatic: Privy Council signatory Lou Zhao, returning from proclaiming the peace in Shaanxi, delivered four thousand taels of gold and two hundred thousand taels of silver to the Incentive-Reward Vault—all drawn from Shu.

sentences.zh: 會吳玠卒，以世將為宣撫副使，以吏部尚書張燾知成都府兼本路安撫使。

translations.literal: When Wu Jie died, Shijiang was made Pacification vice commissioner, and Minister of Personnel Zhang Dao was made prefect of Chengdu and concurrently pacification commissioner of the circuit.
translations.idiomatic: When Wu Jie died, Hu Shijiang became pacification vice commissioner and Personnel Minister Zhang Dao became prefect of Chengdu and circuit pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 上諭輔臣曰：「燾可付以便宜。

translations.literal: The emperor instructed the chief ministers: "Dao may be entrusted with discretionary authority.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told his chief ministers: "Zhang Dao may be given discretionary authority.

sentences.zh: 如四川前日橫斂，宜令減以紓民。

translations.literal: As for Sichuan's recent arbitrary extractions, he should be ordered to reduce them to relieve the people.
translations.idiomatic: The arbitrary extractions Sichuan recently suffered should be reduced to relieve the people.

sentences.zh: 」成都帥行民事，自燾始。

translations.literal: Closing quotation. The Chengdu commander handling civil affairs began with Dao.
translations.idiomatic: From Zhang Dao onward, the Chengdu commander handled civil affairs.

sentences.zh: 世將奏以宣撫司參議官井度兼四川轉運副使。

translations.literal: Shijiang memorialized appointing Pacification Commission Adviser Jing Du concurrently as Sichuan transport vice commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Shijiang memorialized appointing Pacification Commission adviser Jing Du as vice transport commissioner of Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 十一年正月，趙開卒。

translations.literal: In the first month of the eleventh year, Zhao Kai died.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the eleventh year Zhao Kai died.

sentences.zh: 自金人犯陝、蜀，開職饋餉者十年，軍用無乏，一時賴之。

translations.literal: Since the Jurchens invaded Shaanxi and Shu, Kai had held the post of supplying provisions for ten years; military use never lacked, and the age relied on him.
translations.idiomatic: Since the Jurchen invasion of Shaanxi and Shu, Zhao Kai had supplied the armies for ten years without shortage—the realm depended on him.

sentences.zh: 其後計臣屢易，於開經畫無敢變更。

translations.literal: Afterward finance commissioners changed frequently, yet none dared alter Kai's plans.
translations.idiomatic: Later finance chiefs changed often, but none dared alter Zhao Kai's system.

sentences.zh: 然茶、鹽、榷酤、奇零絹布之征，自是為蜀之常賦，雖屢經蠲減而害不去，議者不能無咎開之作俑焉。

translations.literal: Yet levies on tea, salt, monopoly wine, and miscellaneous silk and cloth thereafter became Sichuan's regular taxes; though repeatedly remitted, the harm did not depart—and critics could not avoid blaming Kai as the one who started it.
translations.idiomatic: Yet taxes on tea, salt, wine monopolies, and miscellaneous silk and cloth became Sichuan's permanent levies; though repeatedly cut, the burden persisted—and critics could not help blaming Zhao Kai as the originator.

sentences.zh: 十月，鄭剛中為川、陝宣諭使。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, Zheng Gangzhong was made Sichuan-Shaanxi Proclamation Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Zheng Gangzhong became Sichuan-Shaanxi proclamation commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十二年，世將卒，改宣撫使。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, Shijiang died; the post was changed to Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year Hu Shijiang died and the office was retitled Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十三年，剛中獻黃金萬兩。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, Gangzhong presented ten thousand taels of gold.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year Zheng Gangzhong presented ten thousand taels of gold.

sentences.zh: 十五年正月，剛中奏減成都路對糴米三之一。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fifteenth year, Gangzhong memorialized reducing Chengdu Circuit's paired grain-purchase rice by one-third.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fifteenth year Zheng Gangzhong memorialized cutting Chengdu Circuit's paired grain-purchase levy by one-third.

sentences.zh: 四月，省四川都轉運使，以其事歸宣撫司。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, the Sichuan Chief Transport Commissioner was abolished and its affairs returned to the Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month the Sichuan chief transport commissioner was abolished and the post's duties transferred to the Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 剛中尋以事忤秦檜，於是置四川總領所錢糧官，以太府少卿趙不棄為之。

translations.literal: Gangzhong soon offended Qin Hui in a matter; therefore the Sichuan General Supplies Office of funds and grain was established, with Palace Storehouse Vice Director Zhao Buqi appointed to it.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Gangzhong soon crossed Qin Hui, and the Sichuan General Supplies Office for funds and grain was established, with Palace Storehouse Vice Director Zhao Buqi appointed to head it.

sentences.zh: 又改命不棄總領四川宣撫司錢糧。

translations.literal: He was reassigned to oversee the Pacification Commission's funds and grain for Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Buqi was reassigned to oversee Pacification Commission funds and grain for Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 十六年，剛中奏減兩川米腳錢三十二萬緡，激賞絹二萬匹，免創增酒錢三萬四千緡。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, Gangzhong memorialized reducing the two Sichuan circuits' rice transport fees by 320,000 strings, incentive-reward silk by 20,000 bolts, and exempting newly added wine levies of 34,000 strings.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year Zheng Gangzhong memorialized cutting the two Sichuan circuits' rice transport fees by 320,000 strings, incentive-reward silk by 20,000 bolts, and exempting newly added wine levies of 34,000 strings.

sentences.zh: 以四川總制錢五十萬緡充邊費。

translations.literal: Five hundred thousand strings of Sichuan general-control funds were allocated for frontier expenses.
translations.idiomatic: Five hundred thousand strings of Sichuan general-control funds were allocated for frontier expenses.

sentences.zh: 十七年，以戶部員外郎符行中總領四川宣撫司錢糧，召剛中赴行在，不棄權工部侍郎，知成都府李璆權四川宣撫司事。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, Ministry of Revenue Vice Director Fu Xingzhong was put in charge of Pacification Commission funds and grain for Sichuan; Gangzhong was summoned to the temporary capital; Buqi was acting Vice Director of Works; Li Qiu, prefect of Chengdu, acted for the Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year Revenue Vice Director Fu Xingzhong took charge of Pacification Commission funds and grain for Sichuan; Zheng Gangzhong was summoned to court; Zhao Buqi acted as Vice Director of Works; and Chengdu Prefect Li Qiu acted for the Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 先是，剛中奏：「本司舊貯備邊歲入錢引五百八十一萬五千道，如撥供歲計，即可對減增添，寬省民力。

translations.literal: Previously, Gangzhong had memorialized: "This office's old stores of frontier-readiness annual paper notes totaled 5,815,000 notes; if allocated to supply the annual budget, additions could be reduced in matching measure and the people's strength spared.
translations.idiomatic: Previously Zheng Gangzhong had memorialized: "This office's frontier reserve held 5,815,000 paper notes in annual receipts; if used to supply the annual budget, new levies could be cut proportionally and the people's burden eased.

sentences.zh: 」詔李璆、符行中參酌減放。

translations.literal: Closing quotation. An edict ordered Li Qiu and Fu Xingzhong to deliberate and reduce releases.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered Li Qiu and Fu Xingzhong to deliberate and reduce levies.

sentences.zh: 於是減四川科敷虛額錢歲二百八十五萬緡，兩川布估錢三十六萬五千緡，夔路鹽錢七萬六千緡，坊場、河度淨利抽貫稅錢四萬六千餘緡，又減兩川米腳錢四十二萬緡。

translations.literal: Thereupon Sichuan's nominal collection quota was reduced by 2,850,000 strings annually; the two circuits' cloth-appraisal cash by 365,000 strings; Kuilu salt money by 76,000 strings; market-site and ferry net-profit stamp taxes by more than 46,000 strings; and the two circuits' rice transport fees by 420,000 strings.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon nominal collection quotas in Sichuan were cut by 2.85 million strings annually; cloth-appraisal charges in the two circuits by 365,000 strings; Kuilu salt levies by 76,000 strings; market and ferry profit taxes by more than 46,000 strings; and rice transport fees in the two circuits by 420,000 strings.

sentences.zh: 時宣撫司降賜庫貯米一百萬石，乃命行中酌度對糴分數均減。

translations.literal: At the time the Pacification Commission's imperial-grant vault stored one million shi of rice; Xingzhong was ordered to weigh paired-purchase proportions and reduce them evenly.
translations.idiomatic: The Pacification Commission's imperial-grant vault held one million shi of rice; Fu Xingzhong was ordered to reduce paired-purchase quotas proportionally.

sentences.zh: 十八年，罷四川宣撫司，以璆為四川安撫製置使兼知成都府，太府少卿汪召嗣總領四川財賦軍馬錢糧。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, the Sichuan Pacification Commission was abolished; Qiu was made Sichuan Pacification and Preparedness Commissioner and concurrently prefect of Chengdu; Palace Storehouse Vice Director Wang Zhaosi was put in charge of Sichuan revenue, military horses, funds, and grain.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year the Sichuan Pacification Commission was abolished; Li Qiu became Sichuan pacification and preparedness commissioner and prefect of Chengdu; and Palace Storehouse Vice Director Wang Zhaosi was put in charge of Sichuan revenue, horses, funds, and grain.

sentences.zh: 宣撫司降賜庫錢，除製置司取撥二十萬緡，餘令總領所貯之。

translations.literal: Pacification Commission imperial-grant vault funds—aside from the Preparedness Commission's withdrawal of 200,000 strings—were ordered stored by the General Supplies Office.
translations.idiomatic: Pacification Commission imperial-grant funds—except for 200,000 strings withdrawn by the Preparedness Commission—were placed under the General Supplies Office.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，總領所奏蠲諸路欠紹興十七年以前折估糴本等錢一百二十九萬餘緡，米九萬八千七百餘石，綾、絹一萬四千餘匹。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, the General Supplies Office memorialized remitting all circuits' arrears on appraised purchase principal and the like before Shaoxing 17—more than 1,290,000 strings, more than 98,700 shi of rice, and more than 14,000 bolts of damask and silk.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year the General Supplies Office remitted arrears on appraised purchase principal before Shaoxing 17 across all circuits—more than 1.29 million strings, 98,700 shi of rice, and 14,000 bolts of damask and silk.

sentences.zh: 先是，自講和後，歲減錢四百六十二萬緡有奇，朝廷猶以為重。

translations.literal: Previously, since the peace agreement, annual reductions exceeded 4,620,000 strings, yet the court still considered the burden heavy.
translations.idiomatic: Even after the peace treaty, annual levies had been cut by more than 4.62 million strings—yet the court still considered the burden heavy.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，遣戶部員外郎鍾世明同四川製、總兩司措置裕民。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, Revenue Vice Director Zhong Shiming was dispatched together with Sichuan's Preparedness and General Supplies offices to arrange relief for the people.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year Revenue Vice Director Zhong Shiming was sent with Sichuan's Preparedness and General Supplies offices to arrange relief for the people.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，以符行中等言，減兩川絹估錢二十八萬緡，潼川府秋稅腳錢四萬緡，利路科斛腳錢十二萬緡，兩川米腳錢四十萬緡，鹽酒重額錢七十四萬緡，激賞絹九千餘匹，合一百六十餘萬緡；

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, on the advice of Fu Xingzhong and others, silk-appraisal cash in the two circuits was reduced by 280,000 strings; Tongchuan autumn-tax transport fees by 40,000 strings; Lilu levy transport fees by 120,000 strings; two circuits' rice transport fees by 400,000 strings; salt-and-wine excess levies by 740,000 strings; incentive-reward silk by more than 9,000 bolts—totaling more than 1,600,000 strings;
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year, on Fu Xingzhong's advice, cuts were made in silk-appraisal charges in the two circuits by 280,000 strings, Tongchuan autumn-tax transport fees by 40,000 strings, Lilu levy transport fees by 120,000 strings, rice transport fees in the two circuits by 400,000 strings, excess salt-and-wine levies by 740,000 strings, and incentive-reward silk by more than 9,000 bolts—totaling more than 1.6 million strings;

sentences.zh: 蠲州縣紹興十九年至二十三年折估糴本等逋欠二百九十二萬緡。

translations.literal: and arrears on appraised purchase principal from Shaoxing 19–23 in prefectures and counties—2,920,000 strings—were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: and 2.92 million strings in prefectural and county arrears on appraised purchase principal from Shaoxing 19–23 were remitted.

sentences.zh: 是時，朝廷雖蠲民舊逋，而符行中督責猶峻，蜀人怨之。

translations.literal: At this time, though the court remitted old arrears of the people, Fu Xingzhong's supervision and collection remained severe—and the people of Shu resented him.
translations.idiomatic: Though the court remitted old arrears, Fu Xingzhong's enforcement remained harsh—and the people of Shu resented him.

sentences.zh: 於是以蕭振為四川安撫製置使兼知成都府，行中提舉江州太平興國宮。

translations.literal: Thereupon Xiao Zhen was made Sichuan Pacification and Preparedness Commissioner and concurrently prefect of Chengdu; Xingzhong was promoted to superintendent of the Taiping Xingguo Palace in Jiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Zhen was appointed Sichuan pacification and preparedness commissioner and prefect of Chengdu; Fu Xingzhong was transferred to superintend the Taiping Xingguo Palace in Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，上以蜀民久困供億，詔製置蕭振、總領湯允恭、主管茶馬李澗、成都轉運判官許尹、潼川轉運判官王之望措置寬恤，於是之望奏減四川上供之半。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, because the people of Shu had long suffered supplying the state's needs, the emperor edicted Preparedness Commissioner Xiao Zhen, General Supplies Director Tang Yonggong, Tea-Horse Director Li Run, Chengdu transport vice commissioner Xu Yin, and Tongchuan transport vice commissioner Wang Zhiwang to arrange relief—and Zhiwang memorialized reducing Sichuan's tribute by half.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year, because Shu had long borne the cost of supply, the emperor ordered Xiao Zhen, Tang Yonggong, Li Run, Xu Yin, and Wang Zhiwang to arrange relief—and Wang Zhiwang memorialized cutting Sichuan's tribute payments in half.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，用蕭振等言，減三川對糴米十六萬九千餘石，夔路激賞絹五萬匹，兩川絹估錢二十八萬緡有奇，潼川、成都奇零折帛匹一千；

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, on the advice of Xiao Zhen and others, paired grain-purchase rice in the three circuits was reduced by more than 169,000 shi; Kuilu incentive-reward silk by 50,000 bolts; two circuits' silk-appraisal cash by more than 280,000 strings; Tongchuan and Chengdu miscellaneous commuted-cloth by 1,000 bolts;
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year, on Xiao Zhen's advice, paired grain-purchase rice in the three circuits was cut by more than 169,000 shi, Kuilu incentive-reward silk by 50,000 bolts, silk-appraisal charges in the two circuits by more than 280,000 strings, and miscellaneous commuted cloth in Tongchuan and Chengdu by 1,000 bolts;

sentences.zh: 又減韓球所增茶額四百六十二萬餘斤，茶司引息虛額錢歲九十五萬餘緡。

translations.literal: and tea quotas added by Han Qiu by more than 4,620,000 jin were reduced, and the tea office's nominal note-interest by more than 950,000 strings annually.
translations.idiomatic: and tea quotas added by Han Qiu by more than 4.62 million jin were cut, along with more than 950,000 strings in nominal tea-office note interest.

sentences.zh: 初，利州舊宣撫司有積緡二百萬，守者密獻之朝，下製置司取撥。

translations.literal: Initially, the old Pacification Commission at Lizhou had accumulated two million strings; the keeper secretly presented them to court, and the Preparedness Commission was ordered to withdraw them.
translations.idiomatic: Initially the old Pacification Commission at Lizhou held two million strings in reserve; the keeper secretly reported this to court, and the Preparedness Commission was ordered to seize the funds.

sentences.zh: 振曰：「此所以備水旱軍旅也，一旦有急，又將取諸民乎？

translations.literal: Zhen said: "This is precisely to prepare for flood, drought, and armies—if suddenly there is urgency, will you again take from the people?
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Zhen said: "This reserve exists for flood, drought, and military emergencies—if crisis comes, will we again squeeze the people?

sentences.zh: 請留其半。

translations.literal: Please leave half of it.
translations.idiomatic: Please leave half in reserve.

sentences.zh: 」是歲振卒，李文會代之。

translations.literal: Closing quotation. That year Zhen died; Li Wenhui replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: That year Xiao Zhen died and Li Wenhui replaced him.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，文會卒，中書舍人王剛中代之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, Wenhui died; Editorial Director Wang Gangzhong replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year Li Wenhui died and Editorial Director Wang Gangzhong replaced him.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，蠲四川折估糴本積欠錢三百四十萬緡。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, Sichuan's accumulated arrears on appraised purchase principal—3,400,000 strings—were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year accumulated arrears on appraised purchase principal in Sichuan—3.4 million strings—were remitted.

sentences.zh: 乾道二年，蠲奇欠白稅契錢三十七萬餘緡。

translations.literal: In the second year of Qiandao, odd arrears on plain-contract tax money—more than 370,000 strings—were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In Qiandao 2 odd arrears on plain-contract stamp taxes—more than 370,000 strings—were remitted.

sentences.zh: 三年，蠲川、秦茶馬兩司紹興十九年至三十二年州縣侵用及民積欠六十六萬四千九百餘緡。

translations.literal: In the third year, Sichuan-Qin Tea-Horse offices' Shaoxing 19–32 prefectural and county embezzlements and people's accumulated arrears—664,900-odd strings—were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year embezzlements and accumulated public arrears from Shaoxing 19–32 under the Sichuan-Qin Tea and Horse offices—664,900-odd strings—were remitted.

sentences.zh: 四年，又詔：四川諸州欠紹興三十一年至隆興二年瞻軍諸窠名錢物，暨退剝虧分之數，及漏底折欠等錢，並蠲之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, another edict: all Sichuan prefectures' arrears from Shaoxing 31 to Longxing 2 in various army-support categories, together with amounts clawed back for shortfalls and leaked-bottom conversion arrears, were all remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year another edict remitted all Sichuan prefectures' army-support arrears from Shaoxing 31 through Longxing 2, including clawbacks for shortfalls and conversion deficits.

sentences.zh: 蠲成都人戶理運對糴米腳錢三十五萬緡。

translations.literal: Chengdu households' transport fees on regulated paired grain purchase—350,000 strings—were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Transport fees on regulated paired grain purchase owed by Chengdu households—350,000 strings—were remitted.

sentences.zh: 淳熙十六年詔：「四川歲發湖、廣總領所綱運百三十五萬六千餘貫，自明年始，與免三年。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Chunxi an edict: "Sichuan's annual consignment to the Huguang General Supplies Office of 1,356,000-odd strings—beginning next year, exempt for three years.
translations.idiomatic: In Chunxi 16 an edict declared: "Sichuan's annual payment of 1,356,000-odd strings to the Huguang General Supplies Office will be waived for three years beginning next year.

sentences.zh: 當議對減鹽酒之額，製置、總領同諸路轉運、提刑司條上。

translations.literal: The salt-and-wine quotas should be deliberated for matching reduction; the Preparedness and General Supplies offices, together with each circuit's transport and judicial-intendancy offices, are to memorialize item by item.
translations.idiomatic: Salt and wine quotas should be cut proportionally; the Preparedness and General Supplies offices, together with each circuit's transport and judicial-intendancy offices, should report item by item.

sentences.zh: 其湖、廣歲計，朝廷當自給之。」

translations.literal: The Huguang annual budget—the court itself should supply it."
translations.idiomatic: The Huguang annual budget should be met from central funds."

sentences.zh: 紹熙三年，蠲潼川府去年被水州縣租稅，資普榮敘州、富順監凡夏輸亦如之。

translations.literal: In the third year of Shaoxi, Tongchuan's flood-stricken prefectures and counties of the previous year had rent and tax remitted; Zi, Pu, Rong, and Xuzhou prefectures and Fushun Superintendency summer deliveries were likewise treated.
translations.idiomatic: In Shaoxi 3 rent and tax were remitted in Tongchuan prefectures and counties flooded the previous year; summer deliveries in Zi, Pu, Rong, and Xuzhou prefectures and Fushun Superintendency were likewise remitted.

sentences.zh: 尋又詔：「本路旱傷州縣租稅，官為代輸及民已輸者，悉理今年之數。

translations.literal: Soon another edict: "This circuit's drought-stricken prefectures and counties—in rent and tax where the government paid on their behalf and where the people had already paid, all counts toward this year's quota.
translations.idiomatic: Soon another edict declared: "In drought-stricken prefectures and counties of this circuit, taxes paid by the government on the people's behalf and taxes already paid by the people shall all count toward this year's quota.

sentences.zh: 」四年，蠲紹熙三年成都、潼川兩路奇零絹估錢引四十七萬一千四百五十餘道，潼川府激賞絹一十六萬六千九百七十五匹。

translations.literal: Closing quotation. In the fourth year, Shaoxi 3 miscellaneous silk-appraisal notes in Chengdu and Tongchuan circuits—471,450-odd notes—and Tongchuan incentive-reward silk—166,975 bolts—were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year miscellaneous silk-appraisal notes from Shaoxi 3 in the Chengdu and Tongchuan circuits—471,450-odd notes—and Tongchuan incentive-reward silk—166,975 bolts—were remitted.

sentences.zh: 又詔：四川州縣鹽、酒課額，自明年更放三年。

translations.literal: Another edict: Sichuan prefectural and county salt and wine tax quotas—from next year, remitted for another three years.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict remitted Sichuan prefectural and county salt and wine quotas for another three years beginning the next year.

sentences.zh: 嘉定七年，再蠲四川州縣鹽、酒課額三年，其合輸湖、廣總領所綱運亦免三年。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Jiading, Sichuan prefectural and county salt and wine quotas were again remitted for three years; the due consignment to the Huguang General Supplies Office was likewise exempt for three years.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiading 7 Sichuan prefectural and county salt and wine quotas were again remitted for three years, and the due payment to the Huguang General Supplies Office was likewise waived for three years.

sentences.zh: 十一年，蠲天水軍今年租役差科，西和州蠲十之七，成州蠲十之六，將利、河池兩縣各蠲十之五，以經兵也。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, Tianshui Army's rent, corvée, and apportioned levies for the year were remitted; Xihe Prefecture seven-tenths; Chengzhou six-tenths; Jiangli and Hechi counties five-tenths each—because they had suffered warfare.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year Tianshui Army's rent, corvée, and apportioned levies for the year were remitted; Xihe Prefecture seven-tenths; Chengzhou six-tenths; Jiangli and Hechi counties five-tenths each—because they had endured warfare.
